name: Sangan
text: If this card is sent from the field to the GY: Add 1 monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Sangan" once per turn.

name: Trigger — when summoned
text: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.

name: Trigger — once per turn ignition
text: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster you control; it gains 500 ATK until the End Phase.

name: Quick Effect
text: (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate that effect.
